title: A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the Books of Ezra and Nehemiah (International Critical Commentary)

verification_log.method: pp. 40–41: the altar restored first; "the foundations of the new temple were laid on the 24th day of the 9th month of the 2d year of Darius, 520 B.C. (Hg.)"; against Kosters, the altar passage implies only that this altar had not been restored; p. 101: the gifts "show that the passage followed the rebuilding of the temple"; "darics" vs drachma disputed; Smend says the word would be a later introduction if the list is early; the figures show "the hand of the Chr."; p. 103: qāhāl "suggests a date later than Cyrus"; total 42,360 or 42,308 (Greek of Nehemiah); pp. 114–115: Ezra 3:6b–4:3 parallels the Aramaic account of the rebuilding (cc. 5–6); the Chronicler "made sad havoc of his sources", placing the work under Cyrus; this disposes of Kosters's claim that vv. 8–13 are unhistorical
